Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Technical

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Technical
public class Technical extends Object
Technical-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_TECHNICAL section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x08.
